schema.title: Tags Match
schema.description: How to match tags: 'any' (OR, includes untagged), 'all' (AND, includes untagged), 'any_strict' (OR, excludes untagged), 'all_strict' (AND, excludes untagged), 'exact' (set-equality on the full scope, excludes untagged). With 'exact' and no tags (or []), the empty global scope is selected and only untagged memories match.

limitation: Schema compatibility only; not a cross-channel product acceptance test.
